turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, Hale?
"Heard my points." I've made one, and you haven't answered it. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
"Make noise." I'm asking you for facts, Hale, so put them on the table. What do you have?
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
My son wrote that essay, and you've just called him a cheater with nothing in your hand. I'm writing that down. Show me something, or we finish this in the principal's office.
